prompt: Implement the user-approved minimum Go slice for the governed native New Target command; keep Go as the sole native writer and preserve immutable revisions, idempotency, atomic audit/outbox facts, compatibility reads, and the confirmed UI command.
allowed_actions: Implement Target and TargetRevision in the explicitly approved authoritative service
Add versioned command and read contracts
Add idempotency, authorization, audit, outbox, migration, and rollback tests
Add the flag-gated New Target form and create-to-Workbench flow
Integrate native and compatibility Target reads without dual write
forbidden_actions: Create a Case or Issue and label it a native Target
Use target_projection_sources or target_projection_revisions as native write tables
Create long-term Go and TypeScript dual write
Commit, merge, deploy, or release without explicit approval
validation_commands: authoritative service unit and integration tests
cross-language or generated API contract tests
Workspace, Project, owner, and Principal authorization tests
expected_evidence: Atomic Target, TargetRevision, AuditEvent, and outbox transaction tests
Desktop and mobile New Target screenshots
stop_conditions: Go cannot remain the sole authoritative native Target writer
The implementation would make TypeScript a temporary native Target writer
The implementation would use Case, Issue, or projection rows as the native aggregate
Audit or outbox facts cannot commit atomically with TargetRevision
